note: June 1990 DX/40 ET4000AX 8 MB SCSI. Frozen PIT graphics replay, 32 poses per scene, one world per distant sweep. Not full gameplay FPS. Final includes Medium/High detail and constant view-depth sampling; no skip-first. Bench counters enabled; production per-sample counters disabled.

native_tests.pixel_parity: 432 poses at two resolutions, all levels, world edges, three pitches and eight yaws. Radial/plain optimized rendering including repeat-cache draws matches checkpoint exactly. Detail+view-depth variants exercise all guards/layouts, not pixel equality. Boundary edits/readiness/owner changes invalidate cache.
